name: com.provyan/provyan
title: Provyan
description: Live crypto buy/sell pressure, whale orders, liquidations, exchange flows and tested signals.

tools.name: get_study
tools.description: Use this when someone asks whether a signal has worked for one coin, such as "did RSI below 30 work for Ethereum?". If the coin or signal id is unsure, call list_coins_and_signals first. What historically happened to a crypto coin's price after a specific signal (e.g. RSI oversold, a 20% weekly drop, a breakout), measured on every past occurrence and compared with the coin's ordinary days. Returns case count, win rate, median move before and after trading costs, typical dip on the way, the luck probability after multiple-testing correction, and a 0-100 proof score. Statistics about past price behaviour on Binance daily candles. Not financial advice and not a prediction.

coin.description: Ticker or slug, e.g. BTC or bitcoin

signal.description: Signal id, e.g. rsi-oversold, weekly-drop-20, golden-cross

tools.name: find_evidence
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which signals or setups actually work, for one coin, for one signal across coins, or overall, rather than about one named pair. Lists the coin-and-signal studies with the strongest historical evidence, best first. Filter by coin, by signal, by lean (bullish or bearish) and by minimum proof score (default 55). Answers questions such as "which crypto signals actually worked" or "what has worked on <coin>". Statistics about past price behaviour on Binance daily candles. Not financial advice and not a prediction.

tools.name: latest_signals
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what signals fired recently or how Provyan's past calls turned out. Signals recently detected and publicly revealed in Provyan's hash-chained ledger, with the call made at the time and the graded result once seven days have passed, plus the live hit record. Statistics about past price behaviour on Binance daily candles. Not financial advice and not a prediction.

tools.name: list_coins_and_signals
tools.description: Use this first when the exact coin or signal id for get_study or find_evidence is unclear. The coins and signal ids Provyan studies, with each signal's exact rule.

tools.name: whale_orders
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what big traders or whales are buying or selling right now in a coin or the market. The latest large crypto market orders (whale trades) caught as they trade on Binance, OKX, Gate, Bybit and Hyperliquid in sixty major coins, with value, average price and side, plus how much large buying and large selling each coin saw in the last 24 hours. Filter by coin and by smallest order in dollars. Answers "what are whales buying or selling right now" and "any large BTC orders in the last hour". Live market data, not advice.

min_usd.description: Smallest order to list, in dollars

tools.name: whale_wallets
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what the biggest Hyperliquid traders hold, or where a large trader's position would be liquidated. The Hyperliquid wallets behind the largest orders of the last two days and what each holds now: coin, long or short, position value, entry price, leverage, liquidation price and unrealized profit or loss, read from the chain. Answers "what are the biggest Hyperliquid traders holding" and "is that whale in profit". Live market data, not advice.

tools.name: liquidation_levels
tools.description: Use this when someone asks where liquidations cluster for a coin, like a liquidation map or heatmap. For one position of their own, use liquidation_price instead. Where leveraged long and short positions in a coin would be liquidated: the dollar value at risk within 2%, 5% and 10% below and above the current price, and the heaviest level on each side, estimated from hourly futures open interest. Covers sixty major coins. Answers "where are the BTC liquidation levels" and "which side has more to lose on ETH". Live market data, not advice.

tools.name: liquidation_price
tools.description: Use this when someone asks at what price their own leveraged long or short would be liquidated. The price at which a leveraged long or short would be liquidated, from entry price and leverage, with isolated margin. Name a coin to use its live price as the entry and to get its funding rate and the heaviest levels on that coin's liquidation map beside the answer, so the position can be judged against where the crowd would be closed. Answers "where is my liquidation price on a 20x long from 60,000" and "how far is liquidation on a 10x ETH short opened now".

entry.description: Entry price in dollars. Leave out to use the coin's live price

coin.description: Ticker of one of the sixty followed coins, e.g. BTC

maintenance_margin_pct.description: Maintenance margin in percent; 0.4 when left out

tools.name: market_pressure
tools.description: Use this when someone asks whether a coin, or the market, is under buying or selling pressure right now. Where large traders are leaning right now, as one number per coin from −100 (selling) to +100 (buying), recalculated every minute from large orders over one and four hours, the positions of the biggest Hyperliquid traders and forced liquidations. For BTC, ETH and SOL it also returns the sealed hourly record: every reading written down before the outcome and the price four hours later. Answers "is BTC under buy or sell pressure right now", "which way are whales leaning on ETH" and "how often was the reading followed". Live market data, not advice.

coin.description: Ticker, e.g. BTC. Leave out for every coin with a reading

tools.name: live_liquidations
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how much was liquidated recently, or which coins were hit by forced closes. Real forced liquidations on perpetual futures as they happen: dollar totals of longs and shorts closed by force over the last hour, 4 hours and 24 hours, the coins hit hardest, and the largest single liquidations with price and venue. Answers "how much was liquidated in the last hour", "are longs or shorts being wiped out" and "biggest liquidation today". Live market data, not advice.

tools.name: onchain_moves
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about large transfers in or out of exchanges, or an exchange's inflows and outflows. Large transfers of BTC, ETH, USDT and USDC read block by block from the Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron networks, with the exchange named when a known exchange wallet is on either side, plus each exchange's money in, money out and net flow over 24 hours, and a record of what the price did one, four and 24 hours after each kind of move beside how often it is lower after any hour. With an exchange named, that exchange's own inflow, outflow and net flow per asset and its latest transfers. Answers "did whales just move bitcoin to an exchange", "which exchange saw the biggest inflow today", "what is Binance's net flow today", "any large USDT transfers in the last hour" and "does bitcoin fall after it is sent to exchanges". Live market data, not advice.

exchange.description: One exchange for its own flows: Binance, Coinbase, OKX, Bybit, Bitfinex, Bitget, Gate, KuCoin, Crypto.com, MEXC, Nexo, Deribit

min_usd.description: Smallest transfer to list, in dollars

tools.name: indicator_scoreboard
tools.description: Use this when someone asks where the market is leaning right now from all indicators together: it returns the Provyan composite (one score per coin, re-weighted every hour by each indicator's record an hour ahead, with its sealed record) and the graded indicators behind it. Use this when someone asks which market indicators are worth watching right now, or what they combine to say. Nineteen market indicators (order-book imbalance, market and whale order flow, liquidations, whale-wallet positions, funding, futures premium, top traders' ratio, open interest, exchange flows, bid-ask spread) graded against what the price did in the 15 minutes after each reading, from a minute-by-minute record of BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE and HYPE that is graded again every hour. Each indicator gets a verdict: price followed it, price went against it, or no steady link. It also returns the combined reading per coin right now and its sealed record: that reading written down at the top of every hour before the outcome, chained by SHA-256, with how often the price then moved its way after 15 minutes and after an hour. Answers "which crypto indicators actually work right now", "does funding rate predict price" and "is order-book imbalance a reliable signal". Live market data, not advice.

tools.name: live_alerts
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what notable happened in the market in the last hours. The latest market alerts Provyan sent to its members: turns in buy or sell pressure, liquidation waves, whale-wallet events and large exchange transfers, each as one plain sentence with its time. Answers "what just happened in the crypto market" and "any whale alerts in the last hour". Live market data, not advice.

tools.name: options_board
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about Bitcoin or Ethereum options: the put/call ratio, max pain, options open interest, implied volatility, or which strikes hold the most contracts. Read from Deribit every ten minutes: open interest in calls and puts (in coins and dollars), put/call by open interest and by 24-hour volume, max pain and at-the-money implied volatility for every expiry, the ten strikes holding the most contracts, and how the put/call ratio and implied volatility stood a day and a week earlier. Answers "what is BTC max pain this Friday", "is the put/call ratio rising" and "where is the biggest options strike on ETH". Live market data, not advice.

coin.description: BTC or ETH; leave out for both
